Short windows landing this week — here and then gone.
Nov 12, 8 PMFood + Drink
Mother's Ruin x O' Be Joyful Takeover
Franklin

Mother's Ruin crosses into Franklin for the first time tonight and takes over the bar at O' Be Joyful on Main Street. Four drinks on the list, a tequila shaker and a dressed Tecate among them, and the full kitchen stays open, so make it dinner.

Book it →
Opens Nov 13Event
Elf'd Up at The Pool Club
Midtown

Fourteen floors up at Virgin Hotels, the Pool Club turns into a candy cane forest on Friday, with holiday cocktails and seasonal bites. Daytime is open to the public. Friday and Saturday nights after 8 PM take a $15 advance ticket, and a welcome cocktail comes with it.

Snag a table →
Opens Sat Nov 14Food + Drink
Snow Globe Bungalow at Bacco
Downtown

Starting Saturday, Bacco inside the Four Seasons sets a snow globe bungalow out on its terrace, with a cocktail menu built for the season. Doors open at 5 PM, and reservations are open now.

Hold your spot →
Nov 14, 4 PMFood + Drink
From Grape to Grandeur: A Nebbiolo Story
SoBro

Yolan wine director Nicole Lee walks you through Nebbiolo across Piemonte, starting light and aromatic and finishing on Barbaresco and Barolo. A Saturday afternoon class where the homework is the good stuff.

Reserve a spot →
Sat Nov 14, 4-6 PMFood + Drink
Birdie's Harvest Party
Birdie's Wine Bar

Birdie's Wine Bar pours its way through all of Lost & Found on Saturday to open the holiday season. Two hours of tasting, done by six, and the rest of the night is still yours.

Get your tickets →
Tonight, 6-9 PMFood + Drink
Music City Iron Fork
Harken Hall

Tonight at Harken Hall, four Nashville chefs get a secret ingredient and a panel of judges, Iron Chef style, while you work through unlimited bites from local restaurants and more than a dozen wines and local beers. Come hungry, because that is the whole assignment.

Get your tickets →
Sat Nov 14, 7 PMEvent
Tiny Habits
Opryland

Tiny Habits make their Opry debut Saturday on a bill that also carries Connie Smith, Rhonda Vincent, Valerie June and The Whites. Three debuts, four Opry members and the Opry Square Dancers, all in one night of Opry 100.

Hold your spot →
Nov 14, 11 AM-12:30 PMEvent
ROOTED: A Tea Ritual & Sound Bath
Downtown

Sip organic Rishi tea, blend a tin of your own to take home, then sink into a Tibetan metal bowl sound bath. Ninety minutes on Saturday morning at Tempo by Hilton, before the rest of the weekend gets loud.

Claim a seat →
Nov 13, 6 PMMusic
GRAMMY Award Winner Avery*Sunshine
Pie Town

A GRAMMY winner at the piano, with dinner and wine on the table at City Winery. Avery*Sunshine took Best Progressive R&B Album in 2025 for So Glad to Know You, and she plays two sets Friday, 6 PM and 9:30 PM.

Reserve a spot →
Fri Nov 13Music
The Jayhawks with Mary Gauthier
CMA Theater, Country Music Hall of Fame & Museum

The Jayhawks came up in Minneapolis alongside the Replacements and helped build what we now call Americana. Forty years on, they play the Hall of Fame's seated CMA Theater on Friday with Mary Gauthier as special guest. Doors at 6:30 PM.

Grab a seat →
Fri Nov 13, 7 PMComedy
Josh Johnson's Comedy Band Camp
Downtown

Josh Johnson, Daily Show host and Emmy-nominated writer, brings Comedy Band Camp to the Ryman for one Friday night. He released 38 hours of new stand-up in 2025. This is the version you cannot pause.

Nov 13-15, 9 AM-6 PMEvent
Christmas Village 2026
Vine Hill

Christmas Village fills the Fairgrounds Friday through Sunday, 9 AM to 6 PM, and then it is gone for the year. Go Friday morning, while the shelves are full and the aisles are not.

Friday, Nov 13, 10 AMEvent
Nashville Holiday Harvest Food & Vendor Festival
Midtown

Local food vendors and Nashville makers set up in Centennial Park on Friday from 10 AM. Eat your way down the row and knock out the first round of holiday shopping between bites. Ticket sales are flagged as ending soon, so buy ahead.

Pop-Up Bar at the Terrace
Downtown

A pop-up bar on the Cumberland at Riverfront Park, with real seats and a water view. Fridays 1 to 8 PM and weekends from 11 AM, every weekend in November, weather permitting. Then it packs up.

Life at the Lodge at Alligator Bar
Downtown

Starting Nov 20, Alligator Bar under the Broadway Bridge at Union Station Nashville Yards goes full alpine lodge for the holidays. Mark the date now, before every office party in Nashville Yards claims a table.

Nov 14, 7 PMTheater
A Soulful Murder Mystery
Grassmere

Step into 1956 at the Brown Sugar Diner, where the coffee stays hot and everybody is in your business, for a soulful murder mystery dinner theater. Two hours at Plaza Mariachi on Nolensville Pike, one show only, so bring the friend who solves everything.

Nov 14, 11 AM to 4 PMEvent
Franklin Makers Holiday Market
Franklin

More than 150 makers set up at The Lake at Westhaven on Saturday, and admission is free. Free Santa photos, food and cocktails, plus the Santa Paddle, where people and their dogs paddle the lake in red for the Williamson County Animal Center.

Sunday, Nov 15, 12 PMFood + Drink
Fixin's Fest featuring The Cornbread Cook Off
Harding House Brewing Co.

Restaurants from all over town bring their best sides to Harding House Brewing, and the cornbread goes head to head. Grab a plate, rank your favorites, then stay for the Wobble. Sunday noon to 4 PM, and tickets are non-refundable.
